newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-GRAF SURVIVES SCARE IN AUSTRALIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF SURVIVES SCARE IN AUSTRALIAN OPEN.

text.p: World number one Steffi Graf survived an early scare against Latvian doubles specialist Larisa Neiland on Wednesday to advance to the third round of the Australian Open.
The German top seed struggled with her serve in the first set, saving four set points in the 10th game before recovering to take the match 7-5 6-2 on centre court.
Graf, who is seeking her 22nd grand slam victory, trailed 5-2 after losing her first two service games.
After only 14 minutes, 30-year-old Neiland led 4-0 and Open organisers were looking at the prospect of losing yet another drawcard.
Graf took the initiative immediately in the second set by breaking Neiland's serve and maintained the momentum to earn a third round berth against Argentina's Ines Gorrochategui.
